an9.28:1.1: 28 yato kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa pañca bhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti catūhi ca sotāpattiyaṅgehi samannāgato hoti so ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ byākareyya
an9.28:1.2: khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoniyo khīṇapittivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto sotāpannohamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano.
an9.28:2.1: katamāni pañca bhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti
an9.28:2.2: yaṃ bhikkhave pāṇātipātī pāṇātipātapaccayā diṭṭhadhammikampi bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati samparāyikampi bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati cetasikampi dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti pāṇātipātā paṭivirato …pe…
an9.28:2.3: evaṃ taṃ bhayaṃ veraṃ vūpasantaṃ hoti
an9.28:3.1: yaṃ bhikkhave adinnādāyī …pe… kāmesu micchācārī musāvādī
an9.28:3.2: surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhāyī surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānapaccayā diṭṭhadhammikampi bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati samparāyikampi bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati cetasikampi dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato neva diṭṭhadhammikampi bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati na samparāyikampi bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati na cetasikampi dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti
an9.28:3.3: surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭiviratassa evaṃ taṃ bhayaṃ veraṃ vūpasantaṃ hoti
an9.28:3.4: imāni pañca bhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti.
an9.28:4.2: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti
an9.28:4.3: itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti
an9.28:4.6: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akkhaṇḍehi acchiddehi asabalehi akammāsehi bhujissehi viññūpasatthehi aparāmaṭṭhehi samādhisaṃvattanikehi
an9.28:5.1: yato kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa imāni pañca bhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti imehi ca catūhi sotāpattiyaṅgehi samannāgato hoti so ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ byākareyya
an9.28:5.2: khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoniyo khīṇapittivisayo khiṇāpāyaduggativinipāto sotāpannohamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyanoti.
